deadline.value: Assistantship consideration closes December 15, 2026; without it, the deadline is June 15.

gre_general.value: The biology PhD does not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Applicants should name Biological Sciences faculty they would consider as thesis mentors.
supervisor.quote: Be sure to include mention of professors in the Department of Biological Science that you would consider as mentors for your thesis work

funding.value: The biology section gives assistantship consideration only.

entry_route.value: The Graduate School requires only a bachelor's degree before a PhD starts; the department page lists no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible for graduate study, you must have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university prior to starting the program
